{{Top|leg}}
A '''diver''' was an individual who spent time submerged beneath the [[Water/Legends|water]], either as part of their profession, or for entertainment. Divers generally wore specialized [[wetsuit]]s and [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing masks]], although members of aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]] generally possessed the ability to survive underwater without equipment. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent [[Seth Cambriel]] was an accomplished diver.
